why: `sync(d>0)` during a pending retirement no longer records `repush`, so when the traversal lands it is treated as a plain retirement and nothing is pushed for the layer the player opened meanwhile. That layer is then on screen with no sentinel under it: the next browser Back leaves the page instead of closing it. Fails 1 of 15 in navigation.test.ts: `a push during a pending retirement is honoured when the traversal lands`, first at the `'repush'` phase assertion and again at the landing's `host.calls`.
